triggers.desc: ISO date (`YYYY-MM-DD`), validated by AJV; the mask option does not apply.
Date in the `dateFormat` mask (`YYYY-MM-DD` by default).
Day within the month given by the `yearRef` and `monthRef` fields.

dateFormat.desc: Mask of the stored value (Quasar masks; angular-strap masks such as `yyyy-MM-dd` or `dd/MM/yyyy` are accepted). `YYYY-MM` for `year-month`.

min.desc: Lower bound, in the mask format or ISO; the filtrex `min` rule of the control works too.

max.desc: Upper bound, in the mask format or ISO; the filtrex `max` rule of the control works too.

yearRef.desc: `ymdatepicker`: name of the year field (a sibling of the control, else a root field) the date must belong to.

monthRef.desc: `ymdatepicker`: name of the month field (1 to 12).

lastDay.desc: `ymdatepicker`: default to the last day of the referenced month instead of the first one.

dateOptions.desc: The same options nested, as in angular-schema-form: `{ dateFormat, min, max, yearRef, monthRef, lastDay, validationMessage }`. Direct options take precedence.

….desc: Every other option is passed as a prop to [QInput](https://quasar.dev/vue-components/input#qinput-api).

dateInvalid.desc: The value does not match the mask (`{format}`); `validationMessage.dateInvalid`.

data.desc: A string in the mask format. The errors are reported with the `date` keyword. The picker only offers the dates within the bounds; the input is disabled until the `yearRef` / `monthRef` fields are set.
